title: Shevna, Brother of Hillel the Nasi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Shevna, brother of Hillel the Nasi. (Shevna, Isaiah 22:15.) Sotah 21a relates that Hillel studied Torah in poverty while Shevna engaged in business. Eventually Shevna told Hillel, “Come, let us pool our shares and divide them.” A heavenly voice responded, “If a man would give all the wealth of his house,” etc.

notes.text: Shevna’s offer concerns sharing the fruits of their respective activities. The poverty parenthesis and the unfinished heavenly quotation are retained from Hyman’s notice.
